name: classic-city-core/highlight-tiles
title: Highlight Tiles
description: Marketing tile grid — asymmetric bento of headline-led cards over a 3fr/5fr/4fr column system × 3 rows, with per-column tall+short tile pairings. 6-tile uses all three columns; 4-tile drops the rightmost. Per-card palette color and optional image with Background (full-bleed cover + scrim) or Inline (centered, constrained-width) treatment.
